description: Read-only. Diagnoses env setup — the cause and the fix of an env-related failure: presence + reachability checks (RPC, Pinata, IPFS gateway DNS, subgraph, backend) as pass/warn/fail with remediation hints. Warnings are advisories — a healthy zero-config install always has some. `probePin` is the one write: one tiny IPFS pin.

probePin.description: Probe pin to Pinata (added, then removed) — use when an IPFS upload fails with HTTP 403.

name: dexe_doctor
title: Diagnose env setup
